stations.title: Wendell
stations.say: Is the salad really in the box?
stations.note: He packs from the code's lists.

stations.title: Packing code
stations.text: Gives back lists. Nobody checks inside.

stations.title: Friday van
stations.text: Every box packed from its list, slip on top.

captions: Wendell packs every box from the farm's code and wants to know the lists are right.
Today the code gives back a list and a slip, and nobody looks inside them.
You write tests that compare whole lists, whole slips and prices to the penny.
Now a box missing its salad fails a test before Wendell packs it.
Same lists, same van. Every box leaves the farm with what was on the slip.
